contexts.text: (Melancthon) came to me in his persuasion (that is, in his persuasive way of speaking), and there exhaled from him as it were the odour of leek (hvitlok, garlick); and its pungency strongly affected my left eye; whence it was evident to what the stench of a leek corresponds.
Leeks, onions, and garlick () = such things as are of the lowest Natural; that is, of the corporeal Sensuous of man.
